summary: Small treed riverside car park in parkland, no homes nearby, room for a van.
reasons: Backs onto trees and riverside park
No dwellings; nearest building 58 m, non-dwelling
Sign nearby says P no limit

drivers.seclusion: Trees to the north and east, open park to the south; only building mapped is 58 m away and not a dwelling.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park opens directly onto the park road; room for a van beside the few parked cars.
drivers.traffic: Quiet park road; van stands off the lane inside the car park.
drivers.convention: Cars are parked here; a nearby sign reads P (no limit), parallel.

flags: Low-lying: about 7.5 m elevation, Brisbane River 149 m away
Riverside park may draw evening visitors
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over most of the car park, heaviest on the north and east sides.
cannot_judge: Whether the park is patrolled at night

best_section.where: North-east end of the small car park beside the riverside trees
